crew.overview: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver finds himself taking part in a heist doomed to fail.
crew.title: Baby Driver

details.biography:
Noël Wells (born December 23, 1986) is an American actress, comedian, writer, and director. She is known for her roles as Becca on the Comedy Central series The Birthday Boys, Lindsay on the Netflix series Master of None, and Natalie Greer on the Hulu series PEN15. She is also the creator and star of the web series No One Asked for This.

Wells was born in Phoenix, Arizona, and raised in San Diego, California. She attended the University of Southern California, where she studied film and television. After graduating, she moved to Los Angeles to pursue a career in comedy.

Wells's first major television role was as Becca on The Birthday Boys. She also had a recurring role as Lindsay on Master of None. In 2019, she began starring as Natalie Greer on PEN15. She is also the creator and star of the web series No One Asked for This.

Wells is 5 feet 7 inches (1.70 meters) tall.
